meta.name: get-qodo-rules
meta.description: Loads org- and repo-level coding rules from Qodo before code tasks begin, ensuring all generation and modification follows team standards. Use before any code generation or modification task when rules are not already loaded. Invoke when user asks to write, edit, refactor, or review code, or when starting implementation planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 加载团队编码规则，确保代码符合规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队有编码规则需要自动遵守
copy.tagline_en: Load team coding rules to ensure code compliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team has coding rules to enforce automatically

howto.what: 加载Qodo平台上的组织级和仓库级编码规则，确保后续代码生成和修改符合团队标准。规则会按严重级别（错误、警告、建议）分组展示，并自动应用。
howto.when: 当用户要求写、改、重构或审查代码，或开始实现计划时，且规则尚未加载。

say.text: 请加载Qodo规则再开始写代码。

say.note: 确保后续代码符合规则。

say.text: 帮我审查这段代码并应用Qodo规则。

howto.what_en: Loads org- and repo-level coding rules from Qodo before code tasks, ensuring generated/modified code follows team standards. Rules are grouped by severity (ERROR, WARNING, RECOMMENDATION) and applied accordingly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to write, edit, refactor, review code, or start implementation planning, and rules are not already loaded.

say_en.text: Load Qodo rules before writing code.
Review this code with Qodo rules.
